name: list_free_models
description: BULK export of the published free-model catalogue: every tracked raw model id grouped per gateway, each raw-ID array in natural raw-ID order, including gateways that track zero ids. There is no hard universal output cap and never any truncation, so bulk output may exceed the guidance below. For routine lookups prefer search_models with an explicit small limit of 1-5 rows, then get_model for details of one raw id. Optional provider narrows the export to one exact registered key.

provider.description: Exact registered gateway key. Absent or null covers every gateway; an empty, padded or wrong-case string is rejected as unknown, never repaired.

name: get_model
description: Literal and marker lookup for one raw model id: returns every (provider, raw model_id) endpoint whose raw id is an exact literal match, plus endpoints reachable only by stripping a single delimiter-bounded free marker. A marker match is not proof of cross-gateway identity. Exact ids are never trimmed, case-folded or repaired, and a missing id is a successful empty result, not an error.

model_id.description: Required raw model id. Must contain at least one character outside ASCII blank U+0009..U+000D and U+0020; never trimmed or repaired.

name: list_endpoints
description: BULK export of published endpoints: for each selected gateway, its chat-completions wiring plus every tracked raw model id with its projected public metadata, grouped per gateway with each raw-ID array in natural raw-ID order, including gateways tracking zero ids. There is no hard universal output cap and never any truncation. For routine use prefer search_models with an explicit small limit of 1-5 rows, then get_model. Optional provider narrows to one exact registered key.

provider.description: Exact registered gateway key. Absent or null covers every gateway; an empty, padded or wrong-case string is rejected as unknown, never repaired.

name: watchdog_status
description: Published catalogue health for the current snapshot: tick age from the snapshot epoch and cadence, per-gateway staleness, whole-catalogue and tracked-pair coverage counts, and the snapshot warning codes plus the derived status-only codes. This reports the published catalogue only, never live or private operator or cron health, and it never probes a gateway. It takes no arguments, exposes no public clock parameter and performs no wall-clock lookup.

name: search_models
description: Search published metadata: a sorted, paginated endpoint page. Filters are a literal substring query over ids, names and descriptions, an exact registered provider, a minimum context length and capability arrays. An unknown provider errors; an unmatched capability value or unknown endpoint metadata yields no matches. Sorted then sliced, so totals are unpaginated. Optional arguments: query, provider, min_context_length, input_modalities and supported_parameters default null; limit 50, offset 0.

query.description: Literal, untrimmed substring over ids, names and descriptions. Any string is allowed, including empty or whitespace; null applies no filter.

provider.description: Optional exact registered gateway key. Absent or null searches every gateway; an unknown string is rejected, never trimmed or case-folded.

min_context_length.description: Optional minimum context length as a JSON safe integer >= 0. Omitted or null applies no constraint.

input_modalities.description: Optional filter of required input modalities as nonempty strings. An empty array applies no constraint; members are literal and untrimmed.

supported_parameters.description: Optional filter of required supported parameter names as nonempty strings. An empty array applies no constraint; members are literal and untrimmed.

limit.description: Maximum rows in the returned page as an integer 1..200. Omitted defaults to 50; null is rejected.

offset.description: Rows to skip before the page as a JSON safe integer 0..2^53 - 1. Omitted defaults to 0; null is rejected.
